obligations.proposition: AgentReview generic engine is owned exclusively by aiops-orchestrator/toolrepo; targets specialize configuration without owning engine forks.
obligations.truth_maker: app/agent_review/ core modules with dependency injection of target policies; zero target repo-name branches, string literals, or imports in engine.
obligations.closure_predicate: Static ast/forbidden-symbol check proves zero target-specific literals or imports in generic engine codebase, and dual-target plus synthetic third-profile blind execution succeeds with byte-identical distribution.
countermodels: CM-C0-01: Engine imports target-specific python modules directly or branches on repo names.
CM-C0-02: Forked copy of engine maintained in target repository.
positive_controls: Unit tests verifying generic profile schema loading and target config parsing.
obligations.known_limitations: Requires target repositories to implement compliant config manifests.
obligations.invalidation: Any target-specific conditional check added to app/agent_review/ engine modules.

obligations.proposition: Every review result, gate evaluation, and report binds cryptographically and structurally to exact repo, PR, base OID, head OID, diff hash, toolrepo OID, profile digest, run ID.
obligations.truth_maker: ReviewSubjectIdentityV2 schema and provenance attestation in app/agent_review/models_v2.py.
obligations.closure_predicate: Mutation of any subject field (e.g. altering base_oid or head_oid) produces immediate validation failure.
countermodels: CM-C1-01: Subject OIDs read from mutable HEAD instead of pinned PR event.
CM-C1-02: Report generated without toolrepo commit OID binding.
positive_controls: Round-trip test serializing and deserializing ReviewSubjectIdentityV2.
obligations.known_limitations: Requires host to supply authoritative base and head OIDs.
obligations.invalidation: Unauthenticated subject identity accepted by readiness evaluator.

obligations.proposition: Git objects used as review authority originate exclusively from storage explicitly authorized by host trust model (SafePath != AuthorizedStorage).
obligations.closure_predicate: Host trust boundary rejects repos or worktrees outside authorized root paths or containing unverified commondir pointers.
countermodels: CM-C2-01: External repo path outside authorized boundary accepted because path contains no '..'.
CM-C2-02: Linked worktree commondir pointing to arbitrary host filesystem location is traversed.
positive_controls: Valid in-tree repository and declared external path within authorized boundary pass validation.
obligations.known_limitations: Host must configure explicit authorized storage roots.
obligations.invalidation: Storage path accepted solely based on lexical safety pattern without root verification.

obligations.proposition: Admitted commit is materialized into isolated subject faithful to declared Git tree representation without filesystem path reinterpretation changing identity.
obligations.closure_predicate: Materialized files on disk exactly match Git tree blob OIDs; symlinks, case-folding, and Unicode normalizations cannot escape root.
countermodels: CM-C3-01: Concurrent host-side symlink swap between path resolution and write breaks sandbox boundary.
CM-C3-02: Case-insensitive filesystem overwrites distinct Git tree entries.
positive_controls: Extraction of standard benchmark repo produces exact blob hash parity.
obligations.known_limitations: Filesystem characteristics (case-sensitivity) may require explicit emulation on non-POSIX hosts.
obligations.invalidation: Materialized disk content diverges from git cat-file blob output.

obligations.proposition: Application code and checks executed by review process derive exclusively from authenticated subject, after authentication, under fresh-process binding.
obligations.closure_predicate: Code execution occurs in dedicated subprocess with scrubbed environment and python sys.path containing only authorized paths.
countermodels: CM-C4-01: Check imports unauthenticated package from parent process cwd.
CM-C4-02: Subprocess inherits hostile environment variables (PYTHONPATH, LD_PRELOAD).
positive_controls: Trusted check runs clean and returns signed execution attestation.
obligations.invalidation: Check process executes unauthenticated bytes or inherits host parent environment.

obligations.proposition: Hostile read boundary blocks special files; trust anchor enforces exact built-in str type gate.
obligations.closure_predicate: Reading FIFO, device node, or symlink-to-special raises error; subclassed str trust anchor is rejected.
countermodels: CM-C4-01: Check imports unauthenticated package from parent process cwd.
CM-C4-02: Subprocess inherits hostile environment variables (PYTHONPATH, LD_PRELOAD).
positive_controls: Exact built-in str passes type check; regular files read normally.
obligations.known_limitations: Bounded read timeout required as defense in depth.
obligations.invalidation: Special file causes infinite loop or denial of service.

obligations.proposition: Every material must_review obligation is covered by authoritative fragment identity or explicitly recorded as not covered / blocked.
obligations.closure_predicate: Total authoritative diff hunks == sum(reviewed_fragments) + sum(explicitly_omitted_fragments); zero unaccounted diff bytes.
countermodels: CM-C5-01: Chunking truncates hunk without emitting truncation metadata.
CM-C5-02: Binary diff dropped silently without record.
positive_controls: Complete diff reconstruction from generated fragments.
obligations.known_limitations: Token limits may cause large diffs to omit low-priority files with explicit logging.
obligations.invalidation: Hunk present in git diff is neither sent to router nor logged in omission manifest.

obligations.proposition: No raw source code, internal host filesystem path, or unvetted literal outside declared outbound contract reaches semantic transport.
obligations.truth_maker: Closed outbound projection schema (app/agent_review/outbound_representation_v2.py / RedactedReviewObservationV2) that structurally excludes raw source literals, unredacted hunk fragments, and sensitive credentials with no structural slot for raw literals (per #299/#314).
obligations.closure_predicate: Static schema verification proves zero structural slots exist for raw literals in outbound envelope, and deterministic scanner runs as defense-in-depth across credential test battery.
countermodels: CM-C6-01: Private SSH key or API token included in review prompt due to open structural slot.
CM-C6-02: Host root absolute path (e.g. /home/user/...) leaked in prompt context.
positive_controls: Sanitized change prompt successfully delivered with relative paths only.
obligations.known_limitations: Heuristic entropy scanners may trigger false positives on dense hashes.
obligations.invalidation: Any unredacted high-entropy secret detected in outbound request log.

obligations.proposition: Response is accepted only for exact request, run, payload, fragments, subject, target that produced it.
obligations.closure_predicate: Receipt validation enforces exact match on nonce, run_id, and SHA-256 payload digest.
countermodels: CM-C7-01: Response for run A injected into evaluation for run B.
CM-C7-02: Replayed model response with mismatched fragment IDs accepted.
obligations.known_limitations: Requires router service to echo receipt tokens faithfully.
obligations.invalidation: Receipt with modified payload hash passes validation.

obligations.proposition: Model output is non-authoritative observation; deterministic contract-bound gate owns consumable readiness.
obligations.closure_predicate: Given identical observations, check receipts, and policy profile, readiness output is 100% byte-reproducible.
countermodels: CM-C8-01: LLM judgment overrides failing deterministic check.
CM-C8-02: Readiness depends on non-deterministic external clock or network state.
positive_controls: Fixed fixture evaluation returns identical readiness status across 1000 iterations.
obligations.known_limitations: Model findings categorized strictly as advisory observations.
obligations.invalidation: Readiness decision changes without change in inputs or policy.

obligations.proposition: Required-check evidence used for readiness is produced by host-controlled execution and cannot be fabricated by PR subject.
obligations.truth_maker: app/agent_review/trusted_checks_v2.py, trusted_check_supervisor_v2.py, and trusted_check_broker_v2.py; commands and policy are anchored in immutable base-branch policy or toolrepo manifest, executed in host-controlled namespaces.
obligations.closure_predicate: Required checks require both valid host attestation signature AND execution against base-branch immutable policy/manifest; subject-authored modifications to check commands, Makefiles, or test harnesses cannot fabricate or falsify check evidence.
countermodels: CM-C9-01: PR commits fake check-result.json to repo root and readiness accepts it.
CM-C9-02: Malicious Makefile or test harness in PR returns exit code 0 without executing real check suite, producing a signed false success.
positive_controls: Host runner executes test suite and signs output manifest.
obligations.invalidation: Unsigned or untrusted check result advances readiness gate.

obligations.proposition: Git, API, raw-diff, unified-diff, manifest, publisher representations preserve one unambiguous canonical path identity without collapsing distinct tracked tree entries.
obligations.truth_maker: app/agent_review/diff_acquisition_v2.py, external_path_ingress_v2.py, and manifest_v2.py; authoritative unquoted raw-diff stream (-z) as primary identity anchor, preserving byte-distinct entries.
obligations.closure_predicate: Only alternate encodings of the same Git pathname (e.g. Git octal C-quoting) converge to their canonical byte sequence; distinct tracked files (such as NFC vs NFD or literal backslashes on case-sensitive POSIX systems) remain strictly distinct or fail closed when unrepresentable on target filesystem.
countermodels: CM-C10-01: File with Portuguese accents in filename treated as different file in diff vs git tree due to quoting mismatch.
CM-C10-02: Distinct POSIX tree entries (NFC vs NFD or backslash) improperly collapsed into single path, aliasing hunks.
positive_controls: Exotic filename test suite verifies parity across git, diff, and disk.
obligations.known_limitations: OS-level filesystem limitations (Windows max path, reserved names).
obligations.invalidation: Diff hunk maps to non-existent path due to quote-parsing discrepancy.

obligations.proposition: All qualified primitives compose without subject, authority, or evidence substitution between boundaries.
obligations.truth_maker: Gate G5 integration test harness in tests/agent_review_v2/test_composition_g5.py.
obligations.closure_predicate: End-to-end integration test executes full path from repository input to readiness verdict with zero intermediate mock substitution.
countermodels: CM-C11-01: Unit tests pass on isolated components but end-to-end flow fails on type mismatch.
CM-C11-02: Intermediate stage substitutes simulated authority instead of passing real token.
positive_controls: Full run against sample repository produces valid ReviewReadinessV2 artifact.
obligations.known_limitations: Requires integration environment with mock or test router endpoint.
obligations.invalidation: Composition fails or requires monkey-patching between stage boundaries.

obligations.proposition: Target pack installs, validates, upgrades, and rolls back the same engine without repo-name branches or copied engine forks.
obligations.truth_maker: app/agent_review/packaging/ and target pack verification scripts.
obligations.closure_predicate: Target pack installer executes in fresh target checkout, passes verify, and supports clean uninstall/rollback.
countermodels: CM-C12-01: Target pack overwrites target git config without rollback record.
CM-C12-02: Upgrade breaks backward compatibility with existing target profile.
positive_controls: Pack installation, verification, and removal on sample repo succeed.
obligations.known_limitations: Target environment must supply compatible Python runtime.
obligations.invalidation: Target pack installer leaves dangling changes upon failed verification.

obligations.proposition: The same engine/pack works for AgentEscala and InterLeitos while only target-owned policy/profile/DLP differs.
obligations.closure_predicate: Dual-target test runs identical engine binaries against AgentEscala and InterLeitos benchmark cases; both produce valid conformant readiness outputs.
countermodels: CM-C13-01: InterLeitos policy requires modifying core engine parser.
CM-C13-02: AgentEscala DLP rules conflict with engine-level sanitization.
positive_controls: Dual conformance test suite passes 100% on committed test cases.
obligations.known_limitations: Targets must provide representative test cases for CI matrix.
obligations.invalidation: Engine divergence required to support second target.

obligations.proposition: Reproducible, immutable, rollback-capable AgentReview v2 release candidate exists with qualification evidence bound to exact source/artifacts.
obligations.truth_maker: Release manifest, git tag, frozen benchmark reports, and CI release gates.
obligations.closure_predicate: Release candidate build is bit-identical across independent builds; all 14 preceding claims are verifiably closed.
countermodels: CM-C14-01: Release tagged while open critical obligations remain in DAG.
CM-C14-02: Qualification evidence not bound to exact release commit SHA.
positive_controls: Release gate scripts pass on tagged commit.
obligations.known_limitations: First release candidate does not retire v1 or auto-promote to default.
obligations.invalidation: Any unclosed critical obligation found in release candidate audit.
